_comment: Hand-kept labels for the bounty board (site/index.html): what the chain doesn't carry. Bounties by id; checks by the first bytes of their code hash; accounts and service code by their full hex. The snapshot (snapshot.json) is read from the chain by .github/workflows/toaster-board.yml.
